newsitem.title: REPUBLIC OF IRELAND: HORSE RACING-Dunwoody favourite for top jockey title - Power.
newsitem.headline: HORSE RACING-Dunwoody favourite for top jockey title - Power.

text.p: Richard Dunwoody is 13-8 favourite to be crowned top jockey at the 1997 Cheltenham Festival of Racing, Ireland's Paddy Power bookmaker firm said on Wednesday.
Power said in a statement that Irish champion jockey Charlie Swan, twice previously the winner of the Ritz Trophy as leading jockey at the Festival, is quoted at 3-1 with Jamie Osborne at 5-1.
Tony McCoy is quoted a 10-1 chance with both Norman Williamson and Paul Carberry at 12-1 in the betting, Power said.
